t: Buying a Home with a Roommate in Mind
s: Whether you have a roommate or not, you’ll want to make sure the home you buy is affordable for you on your own. You never want to find yourself in a situation where you’re reliant on your roommate in order to make your monthly mortgage payment. After all, your name is the one on the loan, which makes you the responsible party even if your roommate decides it’s time to move on.
